title: Exercise Results: Tuning a RBM Recommender

cues.en: As you probably learned the hard way, it takes a really long time to tune this.
cues.zh: 你可能吃過苦頭，發現調整要花很久。

cues.en: What I learned from the process however, was a couple of things.
cues.zh: 但過程中，我學到幾件事。

cues.en: First of all, it seems that as far as accuracy is concerned, reducing the number of hidden units and increasing the learning rate helped, but not by much.
cues.zh: 首先，就準確程度而言，減少隱藏單元、提高學習率有幫助，但不多。

cues.en: Even after days of fiddling with it, I couldn't get the RMSE below 1.18 or so, and that's not a significant improvement over the 1.19 we started with.
cues.zh: 即使調了好幾天，RMSE 也降不到大約 1.18 以下，比起最初 1.19，改善不明顯。

cues.en: And these supposedly better recommendations don't look subjectively better if you scroll down and look at the results.
cues.zh: 向下看結果，這些所謂更好的推薦，主觀上也沒更好。

cues.en: So, while hyperparameter tuning might squeeze out some gains in our RBM, it seems like our problems are deeper than the parameters.
cues.zh: 因此，雖然超參數調整能榨出一點好處，問題似乎比參數更深。

cues.en: I suspect it's really a problem of not having enough data to properly train it.
cues.zh: 我懷疑，真的只是資料不足，無法適當訓練。

cues.en: Later in this course, we'll scale up a sparse neural network similar to an RBM and run it in the cloud, which will allow us to experiment with a much larger data set to see if we get better results that way.
cues.zh: 課程稍後，會擴展類似 RBM 的稀疏神經網路，在雲端執行，才能用大得多的資料集，看看能否更好。

cues.en: In the meantime though, if you were able to find a better set of parameters or perhaps a tweak of your own to the code we provided, please tell us about it.
cues.zh: 不過，如果你找到更好參數，或自行調整程式碼改善，請告訴我們。

cues.en: Hop on the Facebook group for this course that we introduced you to in the setup lecture, and share your findings there with us and your fellow students.
cues.zh: 到設定講座介紹過的課程 Facebook 群組，與我們、其他同學分享發現。
